summary: Each edition was reviewed independently against all eleven source paragraphs. No concrete fidelity defect was identified: both preserve the virtue names and differing list orders, salvation assertion, conditions and necessity, negations, speakers, and final hearing/doing/cleansing sequence with Hermas included. The notes distinguish the bracketed editorial “all” from preserved readings and disclose the difficult infinitive behind “speak”; their witness descriptions are consistent with the supplied bounded project reports. Acceptance is limited to source fidelity and disclosure in this submission, not authentication of unseen manuscripts or editions, exhaustive collation, or a claim of uniquely correct interpretation.
